complete_proposed_clause_intent.intent: Introduce moist plant meal B with plant solid N and contained water W>0.
Queue DRY until after the subsequent preparation; proposed later patient is the last rinsed plant product.
Sieve B using its contained water until the selected passing material P is clean powder. Preserve a separate coarse remainder R for later retrieval.
Work P into paste T; ZL KEEP T then KEEP PASTE T. IT asserts FINE at G002 then KEEP PASTE T.
Decant from a positive proper part of T evenly; collect a positive free water portion J without plant-solid loss.
Retrieve the entire existing coarse remainder R.
Grind a positive proper subportion of R fine; leave a positive unground coarse remainder.
Separate the preceding bulk, measuring its fine branch as Q.
Grind the new coarse branch into powder of plant-solid mass Q.
Rinse that plant product using earlier collected J.
Execute the deferred DRY on the last rinsed product.

offered_first_two.semantics: Defer this operation until the scoped subsequent preparation ends; patient must be independently bound to its final material output.
Use the named already-contained WATER in the active input while performing the partition; no fresh supply or oil extension.

further_unlicensed_obligations: IT postverbal FINE result/property assertion and common preverbal FINE GRIND PARTLY resultative scope
SEPARATE Q FINE_PART postposed output measurement
COARSE_PART GRIND POWDER Q fronted input and output-result identification
RINSE PLANT_MATERIAL with a distant previously released supply
construction_cost.decision: The first two proposed constructions exhaust the ceiling before these additional obligations. This is not a proof of a global grammar lower bound or impossibility of all meanings.

choices_or_obligations: FINALLY scope extends to the end of the whole preparation
Deferred DRY patient is the last rinsed plant product, not its written-position active stock
SIEVE passing output gets POWDER/CLEAN and leaves a separately available coarse remainder
IT chol is an output/solid property after WORK_INTO_PASTE, not a manner or input coarse property
PARTLY scopes to a proper material portion in both DECANT and GRIND
FINE at f4r.3 scopes to the worked subportion, not the whole coarse input
qotaiin-following Q measures the newly separated fine branch
final POWDER Q is the result of GRIND on the newly selected coarse branch
closing RINSE uses collected J rather than any contained water or new implicit supply
nondefault_binding_cost.note: Even this shared accounting has nine choices/obligations, exceeding eight. Per-occurrence splitting of PARTLY would increase it. A different complete analysis might reduce the count; none was completed.

material_effect_gaps: SIEVE fixes plant-solid partition mass but V2 does not fix carrier-water distribution or a positive retrievable coarse remainder from this new input. No frozen effect is silently completed.
DECANT can release J only if the proposed paste contains mobile water; this is a new operation precondition, not an observed fact.
No DRY_STATE claim is inferred before/after wetting.

Evaluate the next complete clause after the previous complete clause; no reset.

Two measured disjoint components exhaust the current prepared bulk in CARRY; physically separate them. The FRESH rival instead supplies a new bulk of the written input portions.

rules.schema: SortedPreservation := SORT ToolAdjunct KEEP MaterialNP MaterialNP
rules.semantics: The named measured products are two disjoint exhaustive outputs of the active source, both retained. Their names do not by themselves establish disjointness; the construction does.
Select the corresponding existing partition branch by its grade and store it; property nominalization is licensed only in this construction.
Retain the referenced existing branch separately; no input or transformation.
Select an existing available matching material; a missing referent fails rather than creating supply.
Jointly consume the listed ingredients into the specified product. CARRY reuses an existing compatible solid and allows first-mentioned WATER/OIL supplies. FRESH introduces new listed inputs.
Use that already-contained material as medium of the active product; there is no addition or second supply.

frozen_surface_productions.parsing_limit: The supplied complete clause trees select intended scope within this finite offer; ambiguity and competing parses have not been exhaustively searched. No raw group is silently omitted or interpreted only as a line-number instruction.

frozen_global_effects.CRUSH: Eliminate uncomminuted material into coarse and/or fine sizes without increasing sizes already coarse/fine; preserve desired plant mass and enclosing carrier components. No mandatory positive amount in both size classes.
frozen_global_effects.GRIND: Act on the plant-solid constituent, monotonically toward equal or smaller particle size, preserving plant mass, water/oil component identities/amounts and an enclosing paste carrier. For c,p: c_next=c-a,p_next=p+a,0<=a<=c. If c=0, no coarse material is created. Changes within a size bin remain unmeasured.
frozen_global_effects.FORM_UPDATE: For a standalone solid, update form class from the resulting distribution: all-fine becomes a powder stock, coarse/fine mixture a prepared bulk. A whole paste remains PASTE while its plant constituent changes. Matching remains subject to free/contained access.
frozen_global_effects.DRY: Remove retained carrier water from the active preparation while preserving plant solid and oil; do not identify FINE with DRY.
frozen_global_effects.RINSE: Use the written water supply; preserve desired plant solid and particle grade, remove extraneous dirt as required by CLEAN. Retained water is bounded by previous water plus supply; any remainder is drainage, not newly created plant material.
frozen_global_effects.MIX: Redistribute current prepared bulk, no new ingredient or mass.
frozen_global_effects.SEPARATE_BY_GRADE: Free disjoint coarse and fine branches of the current bulk; positive masses come from the explicit written inventory/named outputs, not universal grinding.
frozen_global_effects.LIFT_OUT: Select and move the existing branch, no disposal.
frozen_global_effects.SORT: Partition selected input into the two explicitly named disjoint products. Feasibility of the physical sorting discriminator is an unverified condition; no universal common sieve cut is assumed.
frozen_global_effects.KEEP_COVER_STORE: Retain/select/cover/store existing material; preserve mass and identity.
frozen_global_effects.RETRIEVE: Select existing free compatible material; absence/tie fails.
frozen_global_effects.SIEVE: Create designated passing fraction plus disjoint unselected remainder; their combined plant mass equals input. Refining fine input may leave both outputs fine under the previous grade threshold. Zero unnamed remainder creates no node.
frozen_global_effects.KNEAD: Incorporate chosen powder and written W/O into one paste aggregate; components are retained but no longer free.
frozen_global_effects.WITH_MEDIUM: Use contained water as medium of the active aggregate; no input event.
